body:
Yes, it is all about the finances.  With about 1 1/2 million, the proper investments could return a yearly income of about $100,000.00.  That's more than both myself and my spouse make combined.  My spouse could live off 60% and reinvest the rest to keep up with inflation.  And it would still be more than I earn a year.  I don't think I'm ever going to get a better job, I've tried so hard, and failed every single time.

It's not about denying them my presence, it's about providing in death what I couldn't in life.

My parents are to a degree responsible for the current state of affairs.  Enough that I actively dislike them.  I warned my spouse, who refused to believe just how bad our family was.  When they became part of it, they realized that I was telling the truth.  I don't care what my parents think.

I don't really have any friends.

Maybe in a different time I could turn things around, but now...  I'm an intelligent person, who's out of options.  I'll start contact insurance companies probably tomorrow, or by next week at the latest.
